steps.title: Inspect Modern Calculator Base Code
steps.description: Review current layout elements and class parameters to construct a seamless 3D physical desktop calculator experience.

steps.title: Create Inset Display Frame Asset
steps.description: Design a custom display_3d_inset.xml border to present formulas and calculations inside a physical, sunken digital screen.

steps.title: Create 3D Gray Button Asset Selector
steps.description: Build a custom multi-layered shape selector btn_3d_gray.xml mimicking a real physical numeric button with real push-down depth.

steps.title: Create 3D Orange Button Asset Selector
steps.description: Generate orange tactile operator selectors (btn_3d_orange.xml) that shift visually upon pressing.

steps.title: Create 3D Dark Operator Button Selector
steps.description: Construct deep dark-toned 3D shapes (btn_3d_dark.xml) for system buttons like percentage or delete operators.

steps.title: Create 3D Red Alert Button Selector
steps.description: Formulate high-contrast red clear state layers (btn_3d_red.xml) representing physical mechanical override keys.

steps.title: Refactor Layout to Immersive 3D Grid
steps.description: Redesign activity_main.xml layout with the new 3D mechanical structures, custom paddings, and sunken LED frame styling.

steps.title: Verify Input Click Mechanics
steps.description: Ensure the ToneGenerator and calculation listeners in MainActivity align flawlessly with the updated physical button IDs.

steps.title: Optimize Layout Space Constraints
steps.description: Enforce robust 3D structural margins to highlight shadow depth and eliminate overlapping flat borders.

steps.title: Validate Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure complete build integrity with Java 1.8 compatibility parameters inside target Android environment.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Perform the final compile procedure to export the complete fully functional 3D modern mechanical calculator application.
